# U.S. Census Bureau

> > Official source for U.S. demographic, economic, and population data including American Community Survey (ACS), decennial Census, and business statistics

The U.S. Census Bureau provides comprehensive data access through data.census.gov, Census API, and specialized tools like OnTheMap for employment statistics and Census Business Builder. The Bureau collaborates with the Center for Economic Studies (CES), Federal Research Data Centers, and government partners to ensure data quality and privacy protection.

## Key Topics

- American Community Survey (ACS)
- Census API
- 2020 Census
- 2010 Census
- data.census.gov
- Center for Economic Studies (CES)
- OnTheMap (LEHD)
- Census Business Builder
- County Business Patterns
- Federal Research Data Centers
- Data protection and privacy
- Survey methodology
- Intergovernmental partnerships
- Statistical resources
- Census advisory committees

## Data Access & Tools

- [Data](https://www.census.gov/data.html): Main data access hub for Census Bureau demographic, economic, population data
- [OnTheMap](http://onthemap.ces.census.gov): LEHD mapping tool showing employment origin-destination statistics
- [Related Sites](https://www.census.gov/data/related-sites.html): External data resources including CES, Federal Research Data Centers

## API Updates & Announcements

- [Census Bureau's API Updated with 2013 ACS (1-yr) and New Features](https://www.census.gov/data/developers/updates/2013-ACS-1-yr-plus-new-features.html): API update announcement: 2013 ACS 1-year data and new features added
- [Now available: 2008-2012 ACS 5 Year Summary Files and Data Profiles](https://www.census.gov/data/developers/updates/acs-5-yr-summary-available-2008-2012.html): Release announcement: 2008-2012 ACS 5-year summary files via API
- [Introducing dwellr Mobile Application (built on ACS data from our API)](https://www.census.gov/data/developers/updates/introducing-dwellr-mobile-application.html): Mobile app showcase: dwellr uses ACS data from Census API

## Government & Partnerships

- [Intergovernmental Affairs](https://www.census.gov/about/cong-gov-affairs/intergovernmental-affairs.html): Liaison office for tribal, state, county, local government partnerships
- [Subject/Topic Contacts](https://www.census.gov/about/contact-us/subjects.html): Contact directory for Census Bureau programs including ABS, BERD surveys

## Support & Contact

- [Contact Us](https://www.census.gov/about/policies/privacy/contact_us.html): Privacy and confidentiality contact info for Policy Coordination Office

## Optional

- [Privacy Impact Assessments (PIA)](https://www.census.gov/about/policies/privacy/pia.html): Privacy Impact Assessments per E-Government Act and OMB guidelines
- [Adaptive Design Working Group](https://www.census.gov/about/cac/sac/wg-adaptive-design.html): Archive of Adaptive Design Working Group (2013-2015) survey methodology
- [Current Census Operations Photos](https://www.census.gov/about/census-ops-photos.html): Photo gallery of Census operations including 2010, 2020 Census activities
- [Meetings](https://www.census.gov/about/adrm/fesac/meetings.html): FESAC meeting agendas and materials archive
